[A560] REVIEW READY

Head: `efea74858dffc482820d4f19c26c38796a57ff75`.
Round 12 answers assignment 6050694779 and review 6050691676.

Changed:
- The MSRP filter observes copied indication data without entering its owning library application. Registrar visits occur outside callbacks. Atomic kind replacement and intra-PDU Lv/New ordering are preserved; callback contracts are cited.
- Standing mailbox/composition tests cover identical-identity supersession, settled link reset in both forms, and retained kind after withdrawal. The three exact `p11-*` plants are included and caught in the standing IF=1 and IF=2 passes.
- Authorized dev `99e4eb6c` was merged with `--no-ff`; lwSRP remains pinned to `9197193e`. The feedback correction adds no mailbox, register-map, RTL, default-placement or shipping-image change.

Validation: all 114 final gate commands return 0, covering every one of the 113 Round 11 entries plus the independent feedback probes. Evidence includes the full firmware and saved-state campaigns, builder, pinned/absent compiler audits, AddressSanitizer, images, mailbox, differentials, coverage and documentation.

- Composition: 49 tests at each interface count; 25 named feedback/review plants caught at each count; 13 independent probes pass at each count.
- Firmware: 471 core plants caught. Saved-state: 435 tests across five shapes and all 109 plants caught.
- Coverage: 22 files at 100% after unchanged exclusions; adapter 515/515 lines and 478/478 branches.
- Builder gate 23h and its five missing-patch controls pass. Pinned SDK audit: 2146 compiler invocations, zero NOT RUN.

The builder/compiler snapshots are `7b47f333ecde4af16e32ca95730f56c3c454d0eb`. The final commit changes only the IF=1 mutation-selection prefix; their inputs are unchanged. The full firmware campaign, coverage and final documentation checks were repeated at the final head.

The builder's unavailable physical calibration report and the compiler-absent instrument remain explicitly NOT RUN. Target calibration and whole-call-chain stack bounds remain unproved. Fresh independent review, hosted acceptance and candidate/containment duties remain with the manager; no reviewer verdict or finding closure is claimed.

The Round 12 packet contains HANDOFF.md, PR-BODY.md, exact gate commands and log hashes, test/plant and coverage tables, linked sizes, source integrity and reproduction helpers. Earlier rounds and superseded attempts are retained. The checkout and dependencies are clean, and all jobs have exited. Peak service memory was 7083560960 bytes; minimum sampled free disk was 114278535168 bytes.
